m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read handoff, gold_defaults.toml, smoke_defaults.toml, and verify DB presence. Confirm handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: handoff complete; gold_defaults.toml and smoke_defaults.toml read; DB files present for 2023+2024 (smoke) and 2018-2024 (production)

m1-anchor-flip.title: Flip quali_pace_anchor_enabled false->true in gold_defaults.toml
m1-anchor-flip.imperative: Edit configs/evo/gold_defaults.toml: change quali_pace_anchor_enabled = false to quali_pace_anchor_enabled = true. Do NOT change any other line. Do NOT change utilization.

postconditions.statement: gold_defaults.toml has quali_pace_anchor_enabled = true; diff shows only that line changed

constraints: Only the one anchor line may change

m2-armB-config.title: Create armB_quali_pace_gap.toml
m2-armB-config.imperative: Create .agent-work/issue-335-gold-regen/configs/armB_quali_pace_gap.toml as a copy of configs/evo/gold_defaults.toml (now anchor-on) with exactly one difference: recent_history_form_encoding = "quali_pace_gap". Add a one-line comment at top noting it is the issue-335 Arm B experimental config.

postconditions.statement: armB_quali_pace_gap.toml exists and differs from gold_defaults.toml only by recent_history_form_encoding

check.command: py -c "import subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run(['git','-C','C:/Programs/f1Brainz','diff','--no-index','configs/evo/gold_defaults.toml','.agent-work/issue-335-gold-regen/configs/armB_quali_pace_gap.toml'],capture_output=True,text=True); lines=[l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith(('+','-')) and not l.startswith(('+++','---'))]; print(r.stdout[:2000]); sys.exit(0)"

constraints: Arm B config stays in work area

m3-smoke-configs.title: Create smoke_armA.toml and smoke_armB.toml
m3-smoke-configs.imperative: Create .agent-work/issue-335-gold-regen/configs/smoke_armA.toml based on smoke_defaults.toml with quali_pace_anchor_enabled=true and recent_history_form_encoding='position_quality'. Create smoke_armB.toml same but recent_history_form_encoding='quali_pace_gap'. Both use mode='smoke', 2 epochs, emit_fusion_train_rows='none'. Set output_dir to distinct per-arm paths under outputs/evo_runs/ to avoid collision.

check.command: py -c "import os,sys; files=['C:/Programs/f1Brainz/.agent-work/issue-335-gold-regen/configs/smoke_armA.toml','C:/Programs/f1Brainz/.agent-work/issue-335-gold-regen/configs/smoke_armB.toml']; sys.exit(0 if all(os.path.exists(f) for f in files) else 1)"

constraints: anchor must be on in both smoke configs

m4-smoke-armA.title: Run smoke for Arm A end-to-end
m4-smoke-armA.imperative: Run: py -m src.evo_predictor.run gold-cycle --config .agent-work/issue-335-gold-regen/configs/smoke_armA.toml --utilization max. Capture full output to .agent-work/issue-335-gold-regen/evidence/smoke_armA.log. Confirm no error exit and that log shows anchor active.

postconditions.statement: smoke_armA.log exists and contains evidence of clean completion and anchor active

constraints: Do NOT run the full gold 100-epoch config
Stop if wiring bug found; do not fix src/

m5-smoke-armB.title: Run smoke for Arm B end-to-end
m5-smoke-armB.imperative: Run: py -m src.evo_predictor.run gold-cycle --config .agent-work/issue-335-gold-regen/configs/smoke_armB.toml --utilization max. Capture full output to .agent-work/issue-335-gold-regen/evidence/smoke_armB.log. Confirm no error exit and that log shows anchor active and quali_pace_gap/v2 encoding active.

postconditions.statement: smoke_armB.log exists and contains evidence of clean completion, anchor active, and quali_pace_gap encoding active

constraints: Do NOT run the full gold 100-epoch config
Stop if wiring bug found; do not fix src/

m6-config-tests.title: Run config unit tests
m6-config-tests.imperative: Run: py -m pytest tests/unit/evo_predictor/test_gold_cycle_config.py tests/unit/evo_predictor/test_run_cli_defaults.py -q. All tests must pass.
